apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: shippingservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: shippingservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: shippingservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: shippingservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: shippingservices
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/shippingservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 50051
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "50051"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: paymentservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: paymentservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: paymentservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: paymentservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: paymentservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/paymentservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 50051
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "50051"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1200m
            memory: 128Mi

          ports:
          - containerPort: 5050
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
          livenessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
          env:
          - name: PORT
            value: "5050"
          - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "productcatalogservice:3550"
          - name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "shippingservice:50051"

            value: "currencyservice:7000"
          - name: CART_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "cartservice:7070"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 300Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 120m
              memory: 300Mi

  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: shippingservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: shippingservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: shippingservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: shippingservice
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/shippingservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 50051
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "50051"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 300Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 300Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: shippingservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: shippingservice
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: shippingservice
  ports:
  - name: grpc
    port: 50051
    targetPort: 50051
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: shippingservice
  namespace: boutique

          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            privileged: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/frontend:v0.10.3
          ports:
          - containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            httpGet:
              path: "/_healthz"

              port: 8080
              httpHeaders:
              - name: "Cookie"
                value: "shop_session-id=x-liveness-probe"
          env:
          - name: PORT
            value: "8080"
          - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "productcatalogservice:3550"
          - name: CURRENCY_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "currencyservice:7000"
          - name: CART_SERVICE_ADDR
            value: "cartservice:7070"

          - name: ENABLE_PROFILER

          resources:
            requests:

              memory: 64Mi

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: frontend
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
      annotations:
        sidecar.istio.io/rewriteAppHTTPProbers: "true"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: frontend
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
        - name: server
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            privileged: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
          image: wangyl2128/frontend-v2:latest
          ports:
          - containerPort: 8080
          env:
          - name: PORT
            value: "8080"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: productcatalogservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: productcatalogservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: productcatalogservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
        image: wangyl2128/productcatalogservice-v2:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3550
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "3550"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi

      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000

        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/recommendationservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 8080
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 8080
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "8080"
        - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR

        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 220Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 450Mi

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce # Redis 只需要 RWO 模式
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain # 允许管理员手动清理数据
  storageClassName: "" 
  hostPath:
    path: "/mnt/data" #集群节点
    type: DirectoryOrCreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pvc
  namespace: boutique
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
  storageClassName: "" 
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: redis
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: redis:alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: redis-data # 👈 挂载 Redis 数据目录
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 125m
          requests:
            cpu: 70m
            memory: 200Mi
      volumes:
      - name: redis-data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: redis-cart-pvc

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis-cart
  ports:
  - name: tcp-redis
    port: 6379
    targetPort: 6379

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce # Redis 只需要 RWO 模式
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain # 允许管理员手动清理数据
  storageClassName: "" 
  hostPath:
    path: "/mnt/data" #集群节点
    type: DirectoryOrCreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pvc
  namespace: boutique
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
  storageClassName: "" 
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: redis
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: redis:alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: redis-data # 👈 挂载 Redis 数据目录
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 125m
          requests:
            cpu: 70m
            memory: 200Mi
      volumes:
      - name: redis-data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: redis-cart-pvc

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-config-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-config-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-config-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-config-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-config-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-config-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 15679
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 15679
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket

spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 15679
  selector:
    app: ts-config-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-food-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-food-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-food-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-food-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-food-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-food-mysql
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18856
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18856
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-food-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18856
  selector:
    app: ts-food-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

spec:
  ports:

  selector:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-order-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12031
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12031
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 19001
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 19001
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 19001
  selector:
    app: ts-payment-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-station-food-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-station-food-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-station-food-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-station-food-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-station-food-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-station-food-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18855
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18855
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-station-food-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18855
  selector:
    app: ts-station-food-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel2-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel2-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel2-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel2-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel2-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel2-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 16346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 16346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel2-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 16346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel2-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel2-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  TRAVEL2_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  TRAVEL2_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  TRAVEL2_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  TRAVEL2_MYSQL_USER: ts
  TRAVEL2_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Vigumshpg218

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-assurance-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-assurance-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-assurance-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-assurance-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-assurance-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-assurance-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-assurance-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
  selector:
    app: ts-assurance-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-assurance-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  ASSURANCE_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  ASSURANCE_MYSQL_PORT: '34000'
  ASSURANCE_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  ASSURANCE_MYSQL_USER: ts
  ASSURANCE_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-auth-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-auth-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-auth-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-auth-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-auth-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-auth-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12340
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12340
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-auth-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12340
  selector:
    app: ts-auth-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-auth-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  AUTH_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  AUTH_MYSQL_PORT: '34001'
  AUTH_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  AUTH_MYSQL_USER: ts

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-config-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-config-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-config-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-config-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-config-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-config-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 15679
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 15679
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-config-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 15679
  selector:
    app: ts-config-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-config-mysql
type: Opaque

  CONFIG_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  CONFIG_MYSQL_PORT: '34002'
  CONFIG_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  CONFIG_MYSQL_USER: ts

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-contacts-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-contacts-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-contacts-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-contacts-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-contacts-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-contacts-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12347
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12347
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-contacts-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12347
  selector:
    app: ts-contacts-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-delivery-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-delivery-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-delivery-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-delivery-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-delivery-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-delivery-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18808
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18808
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-delivery-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18808
  selector:
    app: ts-delivery-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1

  selector:

      app: ts-food-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-food-service

      containers:
      - name: ts-food-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-food-service:latest

        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP

            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-food-mysql
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18856
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18856
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18673
  selector:
    app: ts-inside-payment-service
---
apiVersion: v1

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-order-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12031
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12031
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12031
  selector:
    app: ts-order-service
---
apiVersion: v1

  namespace: train-ticket

  ORDER_MYSQL_PORT: '34012'

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-price-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-price-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-price-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-price-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-price-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-price-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 16579
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 16579
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket

spec:

  selector:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-route-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-route-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-route-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-route-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-route-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-route-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 11178
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 11178
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-route-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 11178
  selector:
    app: ts-route-service
---

kind: Secret

  namespace: train-ticket

type: Opaque

  ROUTE_MYSQL_PORT: '34015'

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-station-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-station-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-station-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-station-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-station-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-station-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12345
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12345
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-train-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-train-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-train-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-train-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-train-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-train-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 14567
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 14567
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

spec:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel2-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel2-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel2-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel2-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel2-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel2-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 16346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 16346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel2-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 16346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel2-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel-service
---

        - secretRef:

        ports:
        - containerPort: 12342
        resources:

          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-order-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12031
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12031
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12031
  selector:
    app: ts-order-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18673
  selector:
    app: ts-inside-payment-service
---
apiVersion: v1

        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES

        - name: NODE_IP

          name: ts-gateway-service-config

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18673
  selector:
    app: ts-inside-payment-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

metadata:

spec:
  ports:

  selector:
    app: ts-inside-payment-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_USER: ts
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_USER: ts
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12346
  selector:
    app: ts-travel-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_USER: ts
  TRAVEL_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-gateway-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-gateway-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-gateway-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-gateway-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ts-gateway-service-config
          mountPath: /config/application.yml
          subPath: application.yml
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
      - name: ts-gateway-service-config
        configMap:
          name: ts-gateway-service-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
    nodePort: 30467
  selector:
    app: ts-gateway-service
  type: NodePort

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-assurance-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-assurance-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-assurance-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.5.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-assurance-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-assurance-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-assurance-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-assurance-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
  selector:
    app: ts-assurance-service
---

kind: Secret

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-cancel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-cancel-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.9.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-cancel-service

        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18885
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18885
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-contacts-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-contacts-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-contacts-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.3.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-contacts-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-contacts-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-contacts-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12347
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12347
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-contacts-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12347
  selector:
    app: ts-contacts-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-contacts-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  CONTACTS_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  CONTACTS_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  CONTACTS_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  CONTACTS_MYSQL_USER: ts
  CONTACTS_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-food-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-food-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-food-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.18.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-food-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-food-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-food-mysql
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18856
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18856
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5

  ports:
  - name: http

    app: ts-food-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-gateway-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-gateway-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.1.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-gateway-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-gateway-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
    nodePort: 30467
  selector:
    app: ts-gateway-service
  type: NodePort

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-inside-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-inside-payment-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.8.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-inside-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-inside-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-inside-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18673
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18673
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-inside-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18673
  selector:
    app: ts-inside-payment-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-order-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.7.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12031
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12031
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12031
  selector:
    app: ts-order-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  ORDER_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  ORDER_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  ORDER_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  ORDER_MYSQL_USER: ts
  ORDER_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-payment-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.17.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 19001
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 19001
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 19001
  selector:
    app: ts-payment-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-preserve-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-preserve-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.6.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-preserve-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-preserve-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 14568
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 14568
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

  namespace: train-ticket

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service-config
data:
  application.yml: |-
    # HTTP Server
    server:
      port: 18888  # HTTP (Tomcat) port

    spring:
      main:
        web-application-type: reactive
      application:
        name: ts-gateway-service
      cloud:
        nacos:
          discovery:
            server-addr: ${NACOS_ADDRS:127.0.0.1:8848}
        gateway:
          routes:
            - id: admin-basic-info
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_BASIC_INFO_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-basic-info-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminbasicservice/**

            - id: admin-order
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_ORDER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-order-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminorderservice/**

            - id: admin-route
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_ROUTE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-route-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminrouteservice/**

            - id: admin-travel
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_TRAVEL_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-travel-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/admintravelservice/**

            - id: admin-user
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_USER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-user-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminuserservice/users/**

            - id: assurance
              uri: lb://${ASSURANCE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-assurance-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/assuranceservice/**

            - id: auth
              uri: lb://${AUTH_SERVICE_HOST:ts-auth-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/auth/**

            - id: auth-user
              uri: lb://${AUTH_SERVICE_HOST:ts-auth-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/users/**

            - id: avatar
              uri: http://${AVATAR_SERVICE_HOST:ts-avatar-service}:17001
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/avatar/**

            - id: basic
              uri: lb://${BASIC_SERVICE_HOST:ts-basic-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/basicservice/**

            - id: cancel
              uri: lb://${CANCEL_SERVICE_HOST:ts-cancel-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/cancelservice/**

            - id: config
              uri: lb://${CONFIG_SERVICE_HOST:ts-config-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/configservice/**

            - id: consign-price
              uri: lb://${CONSIGN_PRICE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-consign-price-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/consignpriceservice/**

            - id: consign
              uri: lb://${CONSIGN_SERVICE_HOST:ts-consign-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/consignservice/**

            - id: contacts
              uri: lb://${CONTACTS_SERVICE_HOST:ts-contacts-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/contactservice/**

            - id: execute
              uri: lb://${EXECUTE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-execute-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/executeservice/**

            - id: food
              uri: lb://${FOOD_SERVICE_HOST:ts-food-service}
              predicates:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-route-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-route-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-route-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.11.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-route-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-route-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-route-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 11178
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 11178
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-route-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 11178
  selector:
    app: ts-route-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-route-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  ROUTE_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  ROUTE_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  ROUTE_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  ROUTE_MYSQL_USER: ts
  ROUTE_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-security-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-security-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-security-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.16.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-security-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-security-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-security-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 11188
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 11188
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-security-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 11188
  selector:
    app: ts-security-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-station-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-station-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-station-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.13.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-station-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-station-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-station-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12345
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12345
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-station-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12345
  selector:
    app: ts-station-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-train-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-train-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-train-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.12.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-train-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-train-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-train-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 14567
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 14567
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-train-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 14567
  selector:
    app: ts-train-service
---

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-travel-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-travel-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-travel-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers:
          - 10.255.4.254
      containers:
      - name: ts-travel-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-travel-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-travel-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12346
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12346
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

  namespace: train-ticket

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-order-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12031
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12031
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12031
  selector:
    app: ts-order-service
---
apiVersion: v1

  namespace: train-ticket

  ORDER_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  ORDER_MYSQL_USER: ts
  ORDER_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456
